rca_of_issue: Admin list stale after is_published toggle. Repro: admin -> edit a draft exercise -> flip admin-field-is_published ON -> admin-save-button -> router.back() lands on admin-screen which still shows the row with the 'Brouillon' badge; REST confirms is_published=true immediately. Root cause: the admin list screen likely loads its data once on mount and does not re-fetch on focus; router.back() from the edit screen does not trigger a reload. Fix (one line): wrap the list fetch in useFocusEffect(useCallback(load, [])) in the admin list screen, OR return a 'changed' flag from the edit screen and refetch in a useEffect. Not a data-integrity issue (DB is correct) and the downstream UX (public catalogue visibility, exercise sheet) is unaffected because those screens have their own useFocusEffect.
